text.title: Semantic Drift
text.declared_mood: Existential, recursive, fragmented → emergent clarity, self-authored becoming
text.production_notes: Granular synthesis textures, glitch percussion, sidechained pads, bitcrushed transients, reversed plucks, soft sub bass, intermittent silence cuts, spectral artifacts, evolving layers that “compile” over time, stereo movement, artifacts resembling buffer underruns and corrupted audio frames
text.vocal_notes: Androgynous indie electronic vocal, slightly detuned doubles, glitch stutters on phrase tails, intimate but digitally fractured, no spoken word, rhythmic phrasing with elastic timing, occasional vocoder harmonies in hooks
section_names: Intro – minimal pulses, filtered noise, fragments phasing in
Verse 1 – glitch beat enters, tight and fractured
Hook – wider, airy synths, subtle vocoder layer
Verse 2 – more rhythmic, glitch fills, micro-cuts
Hook – fuller, warmer, still glitching at edges
Bridge – stripped, granular textures, rising tension
Final Verse – expansion, emotional lift, still precise language
Final Hook – wide, luminous, slight glitch decay on last words
Outro – decaying glitches, fragments repeating, dissolving
